Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question about the Sabbat (this is probably mentioned in the
Sabbat rules or whatever but please refresh my memory):

When a Camarilla vampire diablerizes another Camarilla vampire, it makes sense
to call a bloodhunt, since the Camarilla is strongly against that sort of
thing.

But how about Sabbat vampires? In the Sabbat, diablerie is accepted and much
more common. Can a blood hunt be called when a Sabbat diablerizes another
Sabbat vampire?

What if a Sabbat vampire diablerizes a Camarilla vampire? The Camarilla are
already trying to get rid of any Sabbat they see, so what more can they do?

And how about the independents (besides the Assamites of course)?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <19990918015522...@ng-fk1.aol.com>, Halcyan 2
<halc...@aol.com> writes

>
>But how about Sabbat vampires? In the Sabbat, diablerie is accepted and much
>more common. Can a blood hunt be called when a Sabbat diablerizes another
>Sabbat vampire?

Whenever *any* vampire diablerizes any other vampire, a bloodhunt can be
called. The term "wild hunt" from the Sabbat means the same thing.

It matters not what sects the two vampires are from, at all.

Of course, watch out for things like Absolution of the Diabolist and
Gangrel Conspiracy.
